$comment: Licence policy for dependencies we distribute (ADR-0016). Development-only tooling
is out of scope — it never ships. Adding an entry here is a deliberate, reviewed
decision: it asserts the licence is compatible with distributing this AGPL-3.0 work.

rationale.LGPL-3.0-only: psycopg and its helpers. The LGPL explicitly permits use by, and distribution with, a (A)GPL-3.0 work; we link it unmodified and ship its source availability notice.
rationale.MPL-2.0: lightningcss (via Tailwind). File-level copyleft: MPL-2.0 §3.3 permits distribution as part of a larger AGPL-3.0 work provided the MPL-covered files stay under the MPL.
rationale.Apache Software License; MIT License: uvloop declares both; either alone is compatible.

python:colorama.reason: Windows-only conditional dependency (sys_platform == 'win32'), so its metadata is absent on the Linux and macOS hosts that run this check. Declared here to keep the verdict identical on every platform.

python:tzdata.reason: Windows-only conditional dependency; same reasoning as colorama.
